title: Number to day translator
description: Create a program that receives a number from 1 to 7 and shows the corresponding day of the week using switch.
hints: Each case needs its break to avoid fall-through
solutionExplanation: Each case prints its day and ends with break to avoid fall-through. The default handles inputs outside the 1-7 range.

title: Calculator with switch expression
description: Use a switch expression (Java 14+) to implement a calculator that receives an operation String and two numbers, and returns the result.
hints: Arrow syntax does not need break
For division use a block { } and yield to return the value
solutionExplanation: The switch expression assigns the result directly. The simple cases use the arrow; the division case uses a block with yield because it needs to validate b != 0 before returning a value.

title: Toll system with enum and switch
description: Define an enum TipoVehiculo (COCHE, MOTO, CAMION, AUTOBUS) with a base fee. Use a switch expression to calculate the toll based on the type and a factor, with premium discount handling.
hints: First use a switch expression to get the base fee based on the enum
Then apply the discount with an if or ternary
Enum cases do not need qualification: case COCHE (not TipoVehiculo.COCHE)
solutionExplanation: The switch expression on the enum gets the base fee. Since we cover all enum values, we do not need a default. Then we apply a 20% discount with the ternary operator if esPremium is true.
